scope: Guided menu routes and learning feedback for the existing four keypad emulators
entryPoints: Menu-map entry beside Open on keypad
Emulator Find a menu search result beside Open on keypad

interactionPolicy.start: Appropriate authorised access root; saved fictional panel settings are retained.
interactionPolicy.route: Shortest supported key sequence within the existing emulator and matching access context, comparing documented numeric/function shortcuts and both scroll directions.
interactionPolicy.recordSelection: Choose the relevant fictional zone, user, group or other supported record before following its dependent route.
interactionPolicy.wrongKey: Replan from the actual resulting keypad state; guide only buttons physically present on the selected face.
interactionPolicy.arrival: Stop at the requested menu or field, or highlight a requested choice, before saving programming or executing a command.
interactionPolicy.prerequisite: Stop and explain when reaching a conditional branch would require saving a setting.
interactionPolicy.reference: Reference-only locations retain their evidence qualification and do not receive the ordinary success celebration.

feedback.progress: Monotonic earned progress based on the furthest route progress achieved; backtracking cannot farm higher pitch.
feedback.actualTaps: Counted separately from earned route steps and shown on completion.
feedback.audio: Success tones rise with newly earned progress; supported completion has a flourish. Feedback can be muted.
feedback.visual: The next physical button has an obvious highlight. Supported completion receives a visual celebration.
feedback.meaning: FINDR learning feedback, not a reproduction of manufacturer keypad audio.

coverageSmoke.countingRule: Unique existing model nodes attempted by the planner. This does not count physical LCD screens or claim every target is a complete interactive route.

flows: Galaxy Function route with demo zone 1003 and recovery after a wrong key
Texecom Zone Text route through its sequential fields
Scantronic Omit Zones menu arrival without omitting any zone
Orisec Zone Text route using keyboard input
SHOW HINTS from emulator search results
Mute control and supported completion state

sourceScope.editions: Existing Galaxy, Texecom, Scantronic and Orisec manual editions, access roots and configuration distinctions remain unchanged.

limitations: Hints follow the existing fictional-panel emulator, whose timing, hardware behaviour and source gaps remain as documented in the 0.6.0 audit.
Reference arrivals and programming prerequisites are explicitly qualified; the coverage smoke does not establish complete physical-panel fidelity.
Audio scheduling and interface controls were tested, but actual listening has not been verified.
Physical iPhone or Android installation and comparison with matching real keypad hardware remain unverified.
